newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.AFRICA'S AMALGAMATED APPLIANCE TO LIST MAY 8.
newsitem.headline: S.AFRICA'S AMALGAMATED APPLIANCE TO LIST MAY 8.

text.p: South African group Amalgamated Appliance Holdings Ltd is to list on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange on May 8 with a market capitalisation of 95 million rand, the company said on Tuesday.
It said that some 9.5 million shares of 100 cents each would be offered to the public, with 16.6 million shares having already been offered on a preferential basis.
Following the share offer, 54.7 percent of the company would be held by institutions, the public, management and staff, while existing shareholders would retain 45.3 percent.
The company said earnings in the current financial year are expected to rise 44 percent to 8.2 million rand or 8.6 cents a share pro forma.
A further 44 percent increase in earnings was expected in the 1998 financial year, it said.
Chairman Jack Cohen said he expected the company to benefit from high growth in demand in the 500 million rand a year small appliance market.

"Emerging consumers are the backbone of demand in this industry and with half a million new customers a year expected for our products, we have built a strategy to secure competitive advantage through both low cost operation and production differentiation," Cohen said.
The company's portfolio of appliance brands includes Salton, Tedelex, Sanyo, Hoover and Rowenta.
